title: Standard cotangent transitivity triangle data
statement: Fix commutative rings in a common universe, derived categories of their modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and a standard polynomial cotangent coherence datum $C$ [def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data]. For a ring map $h:R\to S$, define $K_C(h)$ to be the alternating differential complex of its recorded standard resolution, with terms $S\otimes_{P_n}\Omega^1_{P_n/R}$ in degree $-n$. A commutative ring square induces the recorded semilinear chain map on these complexes. For composable ring maps $A\xrightarrow{f}P\xrightarrow{g}B$, let $F_C(f,g)=B\otimes_P K_C(f)$, with tensor product [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] taken term by term. Tensor extension on complexes is equipped with its ordinary tensor/restriction adjunction. Define $u:QF_C(f,g)\to L_{B/A}$ as the image under $Q$ of the tensor-adjoint transpose of the standard map for the square $(1_A,g):f\to gf$. Define $v:L_{B/A}\to L_{B/P}$ as the standard map for $(f,1_B):gf\to g$, followed by the canonical identity-restriction identifications. For any commutative diagram of triples with maps $a:A\to A'$, $p:P\to P'$, $b:B\to B'$, define the semilinear map $F_C(f,g)\to\operatorname{Res}_b F_C(f',g')$ by tensor adjunction from the standard map $K_C(f)\to\operatorname{Res}_p K_C(f')$, the tensor-adjunction unit for $g'$, and the restriction-composition identifications; on tensor generators it sends $b_0\otimes x$ to $b(b_0)\otimes p_*(x)$. Its derived map is obtained by applying $Q$ and the canonical exact-restriction comparison. Given any boundary $\delta:L_{B/P}\to QF_C(f,g)[1]$, define the transitivity triangle data to be $QF_C(f,g)\xrightarrow{u}L_{B/A}\xrightarrow{v}L_{B/P}\xrightarrow{\delta}QF_C(f,g)[1]$. This defines a triangle for a supplied boundary; it does not assert that such a boundary makes it distinguished.
